objective: Author one explicit directional Context Map relationship from admitted Governance v1 to admitted Ontology Lifecycle v1 while preserving semantic and authority ownership.

selected_pattern.meaning: Governance publishes exact owner-decision envelopes. Ontology Lifecycle protects its local model through a downstream Anti-Corruption Layer that records the envelope as a local Governance Event while preserving the exact upstream identity and authority boundary.

selected_inputs.purpose: Admitted map and endpoint owner roles.
Admission evidence for context-map-owner and endpoint roles.
Admission overlay for both endpoint context-language pairs.
PASS evidence for the exact endpoint admission overlay.
Exact upstream endpoint identity and boundary.
Exact downstream endpoint identity and boundary.
Prior owner-selected upstream/downstream direction and forbidden reverse default.

four_facet_contract.classification: Map identity, relationship kind, endpoint roles, direction, owner roles, lifecycle posture, and authority effect remain independent classifications.
four_facet_contract.schema: One closed Context Map/v1 record names exactly two endpoint context versions and one non-reflexive Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle relationship.
four_facet_contract.human_continuation: Generated MAP.md exposes the pattern, contracts, translation references, information boundary, authority boundary, evidence, residue, and drift route.
four_facet_contract.machine_checkable: Schema, exact endpoint admission, input hashes, direction, relationship cardinality, language-reference closure, owner-role closure, non-authority transfer, reverse-edge absence, hostile mutations, and projection parity are executable.

orthogonality_contract: The map relates two admitted contexts but does not merge their identities, languages, models, owners, or lifecycle states.
A Governance Decision remains an upstream authority artifact; the downstream Governance Event is a record and never an equivalent decision.
Information may cross while authority, ownership, admission, and enforcement permission do not.
The absence of a reverse edge is a deliberate constraint, not an inferred bidirectional dependency.
The DDD relationship pattern is map-local and candidate until a separate Context Map owner decision admits it.
unselected_successors: Exact Context Map owner admission decision.
Any separately authored Ontology-Lifecycle-to-Governance evidence-feedback relationship.
Runtime payload schema, adapter, transport, implementation binding, or conformance evidence.
Endpoint context successor epochs that reference an admitted Context Map.
Migration manifest, lineage record, migration execution, publication, deployment, or stable release.
claim_ceiling: A passing CTX04 validation proves Context Map candidate representation, exact endpoint and predecessor closure, one-way pattern selection, owner separation, authority non-transfer, hostile-case rejection, and projection parity only. It does not admit the map or relationship kind, create a reverse dependency, authorize runtime integration, migration, implementation, publication, deployment, or a stable release.
